import sys

def can(n, w):
    if n == 0:
        return True
    r = n % w
    if r == 0 or r == 1:
        return can(n // w, w)
    if r == w - 1:
        return can(n // w + 1, w)
    return False

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not line:
        return
    w_str, m_str = line.split()
    w = int(w_str)
    m = int(m_str)
    print("YES" if can(m, w) else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
